title: Base Read File Record variant 3
purpose: Reach the nested file-record subrequest parser with one complete reference descriptor and a two-register record length.

messages.label: Read File Record request for file 1 record 0 length 2

expected_behavior: A conforming endpoint may parse the file-record descriptor and return the requested record data, or return a normal Modbus exception for unsupported or unavailable file access.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000a equals unit identifier plus 9-byte PDU
function code 14 byte count 07 matches one 7-byte file-record descriptor
descriptor uses reference type 06 and explicit file, record, and length fields
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability issue knowledge is available. The nested descriptor is ordinary protocol-shaped input and is supplied only for parser-depth coverage.
